sara: Heads-up 1: EU region had a brief degradation earlier. Need one authoritative status copy, email cadences, and inbound routing plan. Drafting below.

sara: DRAFT status (for status.redwood.ai):

We detected a partial degradation of inference services in the EU region between 02:40 and 03:07 UTC. A recent network routing change caused requests to a subset of GPU clusters to fail intermittently; the change was reverted and normal service resumed at 03:07 UTC. Traffic and health checks are stable. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident. A post-incident report will be published within 72 hours.

Recommend: publish short status now (RESOLVED), send detailed email to Dedicated & Private within 60 minutes, host-banner + short hosted email in 4 hours, and full postmortem in 72 hours.

ryan: Good. Suggest small wording tweak: "failed intermittently" -> "experienced intermittent failures". Also add subject suggestion for Dedicated: "EU service interruption  03:07 UTC  impact + next steps".

mo: Support estimate: expect ~15 tickets. Please add header/tag "incident-eu-04-2026" to all emails and internal comms so we can filter. SEs should proactively call customers with >7% EU traffic. Ops can provide list in 20m.

emily: Sales-ops note: route any demo/trial requests from affected customers to "sales-ops-incident" and do not push them to the general SDR queue. Flag any renewal/expansion conversations as high priority.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 registered: EU inference degradation  resolved at 1769800420 (03:07 UTC). Postmortem owner: @eng-runtime.

hannah: Ops confirms checks green. Status should be RESOLVED and include "verified by health checks across EU clusters".

sara: Updated copy for status + email header below:

We detected a partial degradation of inference services in the EU region between 02:40 and 03:07 UTC. A network routing change caused intermittent failures to a subset of GPU clusters; that change was reverted and services returned to normal at 03:07 UTC. Traffic and health checks have been verified across EU clusters. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident.

A post-incident report will be published within 72 hours that outlines root cause and mitigations. If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.ai or your assigned SE.

mo: OK to send Dedicated + Private now? I have the lists. Also we'll append incident tag and ticket filter.

sara: Yes send now. Ryan, please confirm the final subject line.

ryan: Final subject: "Service update  EU region (resolved at 03:07 UTC)  what happened and next steps". Looks good.

emily: Sending rules: Dedicated -> account-se (cc marketing), Private -> security & account-se. Hosted banner scheduled for 4 hours. Sales-ops will monitor inbound leads and route/demo as specified.

hannah: I'll schedule the 72h postmortem write-up meeting and request timeline + mitigations from eng-runtime. Calendar invite incoming for Friday 09:00 UTC.

sara: Thanks team. Closing loop: status updated to RESOLVED, targeted emails dispatched, hosted banner queued, sales-ops routing in place. We'll publish postmortem in 72 hours. :eyes:
